verdict.rationale: Mintlify automatically generates llms.txt/llms-full.txt and Markdown page exports, and hosts a skill.md describing agent capabilities—directly enabling an agent to be pointed at agent-oriented docs. This is confirmed live at runtime (llms.txt served, .md mirrors working) beyond just vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Mintlify) confirmation that external AI agents actually consume these files successfully in practice.
